roster._note: Three people namespaces: team_<lastname>.php (2005-2008 PHP: wolfe, hebert, bock, kalish, paull, farshchi, blaug, barrelet, wachtel, schildhorn, plus team_partners/team_advisors index pages -- curated into sources/wayback/partner-roster.json, not enumerable by the dash pattern), /team/<first>-<last>/ (2016-2022 WordPress, 41 slugs) and /people/<first>-<last> + /advisors/<first>-<last> (2023+ Webflow, 50 + 10 slugs). The 2010-2015 site rendered the team as images only (/imteam/<initials>.jpg), so those years' tenure comes from the image filenames and the PHP-era pages.

site_api._note: www.luxcapital.com is a Webflow site with no public CMS API (escalation ladder step 5). The sitemap enumerates 215 /companies/<slug>, 31 /people/<slug> and 10 /advisors/<slug> pages; each company page server-renders the firm's own description, its industries taxonomy, a Milestones block whose first line is 'Lux investment: <year>' (the firm's own entry year), the founders and a comma-joined list of the Lux people who own the relationship. scratch/site-pull.py fetches and parses them into the file_list sources above.

profile.own_vehicle_pattern: ^(lux ventures|lux capital management|lux co-invest|lux health tech acquisition|lux defense leaders|lux total opportunities|pioneer pier investments)
profile._note: Lux's live site groups companies under its own three-word industry phrases ('Engineering + Electronics', 'Physics + Aerospace', 'Securing Life + Environment'); the 2005 and 2012 sites used plain sector words (Energy / Technology / Healthcare, Semiconductors, Biotechnology, Aerospace, Defense). Both vocabularies are crosswalked here and the phrases are also split into single words by the profile's focus recompute (COLLECTION.md §11, the comma-joined-tags rule). focus_min_companies ~4.5% of an expected ~270-row base. The site's own tags carry non-breaking spaces and inconsistent capitalisation between cards ('Increasing Productivity +\u00a0Efficiency', 'Biology biochemistry', 'infrastructure computer science'), so the crosswalk carries the exact variants as well as the canonical phrases and the single words the §11 recompute splits them into.

shape._note: decisions.md: a 2000-vintage deep-tech firm whose live site is a 215-row curated list and whose winners are unusually large (Anduril, Applied Intuition, Databricks, Hugging Face, Ramp, Physical Intelligence, Anthropic-adjacent infra), so the $1B+ share is expected above the 20% megafund default; the guard still fires above 30%.
